messages.author: 73358d388df3a906
messages.subject: error whilst deploying error R version currently unavailable
parts:
Hi, 

I was wondering if anyone would be able to help me with the following error I receive while trying to deploy my app. 

Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 524995948 failed: Error building image: Error building rlang (0.2.0). R version 3.5.0 currently unavailable
Execution halted

Thank you for any help with this.
